value.label: Value

bars.description: Which bars the read may include: 'closed' (Confirmed) uses completed bars only; 'all' (Developing) admits the bar still in progress at the frame instant. Left unset, a column above the strategy timeframe reads Confirmed and one at or below it reads the series as the frame carries it.

offset.description: Bars to step back inside the Read bar set, counted from the newest bar that set admits; 0 reads that newest bar. At or below the strategy timeframe, Developing offset 1 and Confirmed offset 0 read the same completed bar on the live report. A timeless metric (one the catalog serves as "timeless") accepts only 0.

value.calculationSummary: Select one value at the requested offset.

trajectory.label: Trajectory

bars.description: Which bars the read may include: 'closed' (Confirmed) uses completed bars only; 'all' (Developing) admits the bar still in progress at the frame instant. Left unset, a column above the strategy timeframe reads Confirmed and one at or below it reads the series as the frame carries it.

window.description: How many of this column's newest bars the trajectory shows, including bars with no value — at least 2, because the trend compares the oldest present reading with the newest.

trajectory.calculationSummary: Render the recent build-up plus its rising, falling, or flat direction.
trajectory.formula: slots = the newest {window} bars of {base}, present or not; trend = compare(oldest non-null slot, now)
trajectory.nullBehavior: A bar with no value is a null slot, and now is null when the newest bar has none; the trend is null when now is null or fewer than two bars hold a value.
trajectory.emitsNote: window value slots (_t{n-1}..._t1, _now) plus one _trend direction output.

spread.calculationSummary: Measure the signed percentage gap between the base and one operand metric.
spread.nullBehavior: Returns null when either operand is null or the second operand is zero. A day or trading-session level met with a bar's own value reads null on a bar outside the UTC day or trading session the level was bound to, so a spread against a bar is null across the roll.

efficiency.label: Efficiency (ER)

bars.description: Which bars the read may include: 'closed' (Confirmed) uses completed bars only; 'all' (Developing) admits the bar still in progress at the frame instant. Left unset, a column above the strategy timeframe reads Confirmed and one at or below it reads the series as the frame carries it.

window.description: How many bar-to-bar changes of this column the ratio measures; it reads one more bar than that. Null when the newest or oldest bar it reads has no value.

efficiency.calculationSummary: Measure how directly the series travelled: net movement divided by the total distance covered.
efficiency.formula: output = |{base}[t] - {base}[t - {window}]| / sum(|{base}[i] - {base}[i-1]|) over the newest {window} changes
efficiency.nullBehavior: Returns null when the series holds fewer bars than the window reads (its changes plus one), when the newest or the oldest of them has no value, when fewer than two hold a value, or when every consecutive change is zero (a flat series has no efficiency).

rank.label: Peer rank

ordering.description: Which end of the ranked set rank 1 names: Highest, Lowest, Furthest from zero, or Closest to zero. The magnitude pair is offered only where the metric can be negative.

rank.calculationSummary: Read the ordinal of the base metric among its ranked set: the tracked universe for a metric the platform ranks exchange-wide, this report’s coins for a crowd metric. The ranked set holds current values only, so there is no historical ordinal to offset into.
rank.formula: output = ordinal({base} among its ranked set, by the chosen ordering)
rank.nullBehavior: Returns null when the ranked set carries no entry for the asset.
rank.note: Current values only — no historical offset. Allowed orderings are per-metric policy (see rankOrderings), NOT derivable from whether the metric can be negative.

levelInteraction.calculationSummary: Classify what the newest bar did against a price level: a touch within the buffer, or a rejection that pierced the level and closed back, on the side the prior close stood.
levelInteraction.formula: output = levelInteraction(bar t, close t−1, {base}[t], {base} in force when bar t opened, buffer {buffer} bps)
levelInteraction.nullBehavior: Returns null when the series holds no prior bar, a price or the level at the newest bar is absent, the level in force when the bar opened is absent (the prior bar's level, for a level computed from its own bar), or either level is not positive. A day or trading-session level reads null on a bar outside the UTC day or trading session it was bound to, so the last bar before the roll is not classified against the next period's level.

bars.description: Which bars the read may include: 'closed' (Confirmed) uses completed bars only; 'all' (Developing) admits the bar still in progress at the frame instant. buffer.description: How near a TOUCH must come to the level, in whole basis points of the level (0–500). At 0 the bar must reach the level and close on it to read TOUCH. A REJECT pierces the level itself and ignores the buffer.
